verdict.rationale: Agent Studio explicitly generates a production-ready agent (prompts/flows) from a short use-case description with 'no prompt engineering, no guesswork' (bolna-docs-29), and templates can be cloned/customized (bolna-docs-5, bolna-docs-33), supporting AI-assisted authoring. However, there's no evidence of AI generating or improving test cases, nor independent/hands-on corroboration of Agent Studio's output quality. Missing for 10: test-case generation from description, iterative AI-assisted prompt refinement details, third-party validation.
